draft.title: The nature of the war
card: The Viet Cong and North Vietnamese army used ambushes, booby traps and tunnels. Small groups struck, then melted away among the local people.
The United States had far more firepower, aircraft and equipment. It tried to use this to wear down the enemy.
The United States bombed targets from the air, in the North and in the South. The aim was to cut supplies and break the enemy's will to fight.
Ground units went into the countryside to find enemy fighters and kill them. It was hard to tell fighters from villagers, so these missions often failed to win lasting control of an area.
draft.remember: A guerrilla enemy hid among the people. The United States answered with firepower and sweeps through the countryside.

a.q: Why were tunnels, ambushes and booby traps useful to the Viet Cong?
opts: They let small groups strike and then vanish
They allowed large armies to fight set battles
They gave the Viet Cong control of the skies
They matched the firepower of American units
a.why: Guerrilla tactics let small forces attack and then disappear among the people and terrain. They did not give the Viet Cong the large armies, air power or firepower that the United States had, so those options are wrong.
a.clue: Think about how a weaker force can fight a stronger one.

b.q: A US company enters a village in the South to find enemy fighters. It finds only farmers and leaves, and the Viet Cong return days later. Which feature of the war does this best show?
opts: Search and destroy missions struggled to hold ground
Bombing had cut off every enemy supply line
Guerrilla tactics were failing against US troops
The Viet Cong had no support among villagers
b.why: Search and destroy missions tried to find and kill fighters, but it was hard to tell them from villagers, so the US often could not hold an area. The Viet Cong returning shows guerrilla tactics were working, not failing.
b.clue: Ask what the US troops could not do after they left.

a.best: They let small groups strike and then vanish

b.best: Search and destroy missions struggled to hold ground

check.summary: No problems found. The card, remember line, both questions and both explanations match the card and the history of the war.
